title: Complete the current design and receive its original planning evidence
instruction: Read the current REQ and supplied design/template/material paths. Complete the actual architecture boundaries, data/state/error/recovery, integration and contract decisions; record relevant alternatives, risks and necessary real human direction judgments in the existing ADR/materials. Reuse the current affected module truth: update applicable UI/scenario work for UI changes, or service behavior/scenario work when relevant without UI; do not invent unrelated work. Check applicable scenario bridge/generate/validate results as real design work. Then self-review the actual deliverables. Fill only the existing answer.conclusion and answer.architecture_path; keep conclusion empty while work or necessary judgment is unfinished. A pass is this professional self-review, not an independent certification of every task. Saving continues the original stage outlet; no issue, evidence registration or repeated report is required.

conclusion.question: After the actual design work and necessary human direction judgments, has your design self-review passed? Leave this field empty/null while unfinished; actual missing work will be reported without recording a passing decision.

architecture_path.question: What is the actual current docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE-*.md path? Use the supplied architecture template and current project materials; finish/lock the actual design when ready. The system reads the document; do not copy hashes, evidence IDs or permissions.
